page_title: BAY 4-2 HEI | Bayern Munich v Heidenheim 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+1' The attendance is 75000.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste will be replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).

85' 4 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Mathys Tel is pounced on by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich). His close-range strike flashes past Kevin Muller and into the bottom left corner. 4:2.
85' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
83' Benedikt Gimber goes off the pitch and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) comes on.
83' The resulting corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
75' Substitution. Alphonso Davies has come on for Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).
72' 3 - 2 Goal! Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:2.
70' 2 - 2 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) receives the ball after one of the defenders fails to make a clearance and sends the ball into the back of the net!
68' Referee Harm Osmers points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Heidenheim players celebrate.
67' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
67' 2 - 1 Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) latched on to a very good cross inside the penalty area and buried the ball inside the left post.
64' The percentage of ball possession is – 67:33.
61' Substitution. Thomas Muller makes his way off the pitch and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
61' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) replaces Dayot Upamecano.
61' It's time for a substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Serge Gnabry.
61' Substitution. Norman Theuerkauf did his best and is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
61' Substitution. Lennard Maloney leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).

58' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Kevin Muller was alert and the score remained the same.
56' 5:0 – the corner kicks stats.
53' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Bayern Munich as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

53' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayern Munich players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Harm Osmers interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

50' Jonas Fohrenbach sprays a pass out to Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
46' The whistle blows and Harm Osmers starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' 2 - 0 Goal! Leroy Sane launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), whose accurate header from near the penalty spot went into the right side of the goal. It's 2:0.
44' The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.

43' Kevin Muller was forced into action to thwart Bouna Sarr (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. Bayern Munich win a corner.
41' The ball is cleared after Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Harm Osmers saw the whole situation.
37' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

36' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
35' 69:31 – the ratio of ball possession.

33' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
31' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
29' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will take a throw-in.
26' Bouna Sarr (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

24' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
24' An attempted cross from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
22' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
20' Bayern Munich string together a series of short passes.

18' The corner kick is deflected to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
18' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Leroy Sane, then sends the ball inside the right post. 1:0.
12' The corner is flicked onto Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
12' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

11' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
10' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post.
9' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Bayern Munich have been awarded a free kick.
6' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
3' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers will referee today's match.
